Task FIX-AUDITOR-EMPTYTABLE-CHECK-NO-WRITER-DISCRIMINATOR (po triage 2026-08-06, origin signals sys-20260806T065701-7915 / -55e4 / -49e3). agent-father landed the full policy spec in its own commit_zone (docs/agents/) — see below. The actuator that would make the policy take effect lives outside agent-father's zone (`.claude/commands/crons/` is not in {docs/agents/, docs/agent-memory/, .claude/skills/, .claude/agents/} per .claude/skills/commit-boundary/SKILL.md's zone table), so the remaining step needs a developer/cross-service dispatch (same class as the prior notebook-compose-actuator handoff, commit c72b5ca34 precedent: 'scripts/ is developer's zone' — this is the sibling case for .claude/commands/crons/).

DONE by agent-father (in-zone):
- New docs/agents/system-auditor/flow/data-writer-provenance.md: canonical D-DATA dimension entry (previously ZERO registry entry existed for the AUDIT_TIER=DATA check family — audit-dimensions.md only documents Tiers 1-5, and that file is already at its own 200L hard cap so this was split out per its own header instruction). Contains: (1) the writer-provenance discriminator — classes (a) scheduled/pipeline writer (may stay CRITICAL), (b) no production writer at all (INFO ceiling), (c) on-demand user-tool-only writer (INFO/WARN ceiling, empty = expected steady state); (2) a missing-table-vs-empty-table distinction (SCHEMA-MISSING is a different, always-reported class — fixes the pdf_documents finding rendered identically to a real 0-row empty table); (3) a seeded known-table classification table (price_alerts=c, alert_engine_records=b, deep_fetch_stats=a-adjacent/unresolved, daily_ohlcv/market_prices=a); (4) an explicit negative-control requirement (class (a) tables must still fire CRITICAL — do not let this fix over-silence); (5) a naming note that the informal db1/db2/db3/c04 labels in scripts/db-integrity-counts.sh collide in appearance with flow/main.md's OFFICIAL Tier-3 C-04/C-08 checks (different meaning) and should be renamed.
- docs/agents/system-auditor/flow/main.md: one-line changelog + one new AUDIT_TIER extraction bullet documenting the AUDIT_TIER=DATA gap (currently falls through to the AUDIT_TIER=3 default, unchanged behavior — no dispatch rewire, policy-pointer only) and cross-referencing the new file.

NEEDS DEVELOPER (outside agent-father's commit_zone — .claude/commands/crons/, and optionally scripts/):

1) PRIMARY — transcribe docs/agents/system-auditor/flow/data-writer-provenance.md §1-§2 into `.claude/commands/crons/cron-db-data-integrity.md`'s ANOMALY CLASSES point 1 (FAIL/MISSING), so the next live cycle actually applies the discriminator instead of the current 'a table that should have rows is empty/0' heuristic with no writer-check. Minimum viable: add the 3-class table + the missing-vs-empty SELECT-1-from-sqlite_master check as explicit steps the subagent must run before assigning severity to any FAIL/MISSING finding.

2) PREFERRED (per the cron file's own 'Deeper integration (optional, later)' note, and more testable than free-text): promote this into a real, deterministic check — either a first-class AUDIT_TIER=DATA branch in docs/agents/system-auditor/flow/main.md (agent-father's zone, but the underlying grep-for-INSERT-INTO classification logic needs a script agent-father cannot author) backed by a new scripts/db-empty-table-classify.sh <table> (mirrors scripts/db-integrity-counts.sh's pattern: run once, emit JSON {table, exists, class, writer_sites[]}, no LLM judgment call). This removes the false-positive class at the source instead of relying on the LLM subagent correctly applying free-text policy every cycle.

3) Rename the informal c04/db1/db2/db3 labels in scripts/db-integrity-counts.sh's JSON output (or at minimum the cron prompt's narration of them) to avoid colliding in appearance with flow/main.md's official Tier-3 C-04 (low-confidence BCTC rows) / C-08 (orphaned alerts) — po's live evidence flagged financial_reports actual=30 vs live raw count 257, and alerts actual=42 vs 144, reading as raw row counts when they are not; naming the undocumented window/predicate stops that misread.

Verification (replay requirement per the row's AC — 'the two CRITICALs must not re-fire, while a genuinely-broken pipeline table still does') can only run after (1) or (2) lands; a negative-control fixture (a class-(a) table forced empty must still fire CRITICAL) should ship with it, not be assumed.
